recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見數個中大型原始細胞（blasts），細胞核一側有淡染的凹陷區（杯狀核, cup-like nuclei），細胞質少且無明顯顆粒；此型態常見於 NPM1 突變合併 FLT3-ITD 的 AML。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant agranular pale-blue cytoplasm
Nuclear invagination producing a pale, clear indentation at one pole (cup-like / fish-mouth nuclei)
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved due to image blur
Single small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin for size comparison
Background red cells without obvious nucleated red cells; no Auer rods visible
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, scant agranular cytoplasm, and fine chromatin. Several blasts display a prominent pale nuclear invagination at one edge, imparting a cup-like morphology. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not identified, and image resolution limits evaluation of nucleoli. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with NPM1 mutation and FLT3-ITD.

ddx.vs: APL blasts have bilobed/folded 'butterfly' nuclei with fine cytoplasmic granules and Auer rod bundles, and PML::RARA is detected, whereas cup-like nuclei show a single invagination without granules.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear indentations but are MPO-negative and TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive, whereas NPM1-mutated AML blasts are MPO-positive, often CD34-negative and HLA-DR-negative.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with delicate folded nuclei and are NSE-positive, lacking the sharply demarcated cup-like invagination.
